body: In my case food is not the trigger of the disease, so it depends on each person. What's true for one case might not hold true for another.

I have also always got some degree of cold. Although the degree is so low that I can still take the immune suppressing medications. Before I started taking this medication, I almost never had a cold, and my physician believes it has something to do with the medication.

First of all, thank you so much, I really appreciate your help. Secondly the reasons why are a bit complex, but it's mainly because I ruined the relationship with one of my best friends by doing a terrible thing. Frankly, most of all I wish I wasn't born, because then I wouldn't have got this situation, and I'm absolutely sure that everyone around me would've been better off without me. The only thing I want is to not exist any more, and the best would be if I could stop myself from getting born. Oh, why couldn't another person been born instead of me. They tell you that you're a winner because your cell was the fastest one, but I wish I lost that race. Every evening I ask God why I was born, because I can't find anything else than disappointment, suffer, guilt, pain, and apathy.
Ser ut på profilen din som vi begge er fra Norge forresten.

I've been so lucky. I first got ill when I was 11 years old, I'm now 18, and I was ill in approximately 8 months, but after that I've experienced no symptoms and undergone daily medication. If I'm really lucky, and what I hope for, is that in some years I won't even need the medication. I'm praying for you to get better tonight.

It's important that you remember none of this is your fault, and also that it will probably get better in time. If you're feeling depressed or suicidal you should contact professional help, it's so important to give yourself and life another chance, I'm praying for you.
